rationale: Georgi is actively hiring for execution-focused GTM roles at Rilo and runs hackathons to surface builders—Louan's deep ML and computer vision expertise in neuroimaging could inform novel applications of AI agents in specialized domains. While their core focuses differ (medical imaging vs. GTM automation), Louan's hands-on experience building applied ML pipelines with PyTorch and modern architectures aligns with the technical rigor Georgi values, and this hackathon is a natural venue to explore whether agentic workflows could enhance clinical AI workflows.
intro_message: Louan, meet Georgi — he's building AI-powered workflow automation at Rilo and is deeply invested in how applied ML engineers think about scaling systems; worth a conversation about agentic approaches to specialized domains like neuroimaging.
